# lean-pkg site check

read-only: check the site in DIR (default docs): generated pages current and linked, Markdown inside HTML blocks, mathematics, the noindex while private, the files it serves, a shadowing index.html; hand-written counts are warnings; exit 0/1.

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg site check [--dir DIR] [--repo DIR] [--no-registry]
                    [--allow-private-manuscript] [--json] [NAME]
```

## Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `NAME` |   |
| `--dir DIR` | the site directory, relative to the repository root (default: docs) |
| `--repo DIR` | with NAME: check this checkout of the package instead of the registered local_path |
| `--no-registry` | read no registry record: the repository is the current directory; the checks that need the record (generated pages current, the noindex against the visibility) are reported as not checked (the form a package's CI runs) |
| `--allow-private-manuscript` | as for page: render the generated pages of a package whose manuscript is unposted |

## Details

| Form | What it does | Key flags |
|---|---|---|
| `site check NAME` | read-only, [proposal 0012](../proposals/0012-site-standard.md) phase 1: the package's documentation site in `DIR` (default `docs`), of any kind: `static` (`DIR/.nojekyll`), `mkdocs` (`mkdocs.yml` whose `docs_dir` is `DIR`) or `jekyll`. Fails on a generated page (`verification.md`, `coverage.md`) stale against `page --site` or not linked, Markdown inside an HTML block, mathematics without MathJax in the head, the noindex meta tag missing while the record's visibility is private (or present once public), a served copy of a build input, and an `index.html` shadowing `index.md`; warns about the opt-in key, counts, versions and commits written by hand outside generated blocks, a hand-written page under a generated name, and unclassified served files. Verdict first; exit 0 or 1; `--json` `{ok, name, dir, kind, opt_in, registry, generated[], stale[], links, html_blocks[], counts[], exemptions[], math, noindex, served, shadowing_index_html, binding, snapshot, problems[], warnings[]}` ([The site standard](../site.md)) | `[--dir DIR]` `[--repo DIR]` `[--allow-private-manuscript]` |
| `site check --no-registry` (or no `NAME`) | the CI form: the repository is the current directory and no registry record is read, so the generated-page comparison and the noindex-against-visibility check are listed as not checked; `--repo` needs `NAME` (exit 2) | `[--dir DIR]` |

## Examples

Check the package's documentation site in docs/ (Jekyll, MkDocs or static) against the registry record.

```bash
lean-pkg site check my-proof
```

The CI form, in the checkout; the checks that need the record are listed as not checked.

```bash
lean-pkg site check --no-registry
```

Sample output:

```text
site check: (no registry): OK; jekyll site in docs/, not opted in; 0 problem(s), 3 warning(s)
  ! not opted in: add `lean_pkg_site: 1` to docs/_config.yml (proposal 0012)
  ...
```
